translations.web: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”
translations.bsb: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her.
translations.kjv: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.
translations.asv: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye saints, and ye apostles, and ye prophets; for God hath judged your judgment on her.
